scope: Preparation only; not an additional active cycle or acceptance claim

findings.fact: Ordinary run events are persisted synchronously before forwarding; completion persists a final record and calls orphan reconciliation. Profile selection changes its IPC generation and runtime selection, but does not expose a migration freeze/drain operation.
findings.next: Design explicit new-run admission closure and owned-child termination proof before quiescing the note engine. Do not substitute profile IPC drain for provider/MCP/goal teardown.

findings.fact: isDirty and flush exist; canClose refuses an unsaved Paper. The open buffer survives a refused save, but there is no durable migration snapshot/restore for the unsaved canvas. Mounted source probe now reproduces that recoverySnapshot plus flush omits an actively composing note label; retain raw composition or refuse preparation until it settles.
findings.next: Retain an owner/revision-qualified human buffer durably before offering cutover or restart. Test delayed acknowledgement and newer typing while preparing; never mark an unacknowledged buffer saved.

findings.fact: Quiescence is internal and has no reopen/reconciliation API. Failed or killed admitted mutations remain unresolved; ordinary operations can continue while open, but a seal must refuse unresolved records.
findings.next: Reconcile against exact owned receipts/server state and source comparison before any abort/reopen or selection. Advance generation on an explicit reconciled abort; never revive old worker authority.

findings.fact: An isolated synthetic20Hz stream (200 events, two runs per variant) retains exact transcript text. Baseline medians19.6/22.3ms per event; fenced45.2/49.6ms, with max dispatch lag825/2445ms. A20-event filesystem profile counted15459 lstat calls and126 fsync calls. This is measured persistence-path overhead, not native UI/provider latency.
findings.next: Bound/coalesce consecutive text/thinking deltas before assigning emitted event sequence numbers, then preserve existing synchronous persist-before-forward. Flush before tools, approvals, terminal events, cancellation and driver completion; isolate runs, cap bytes/time and surface sink failure. Avoid buffering already acknowledged events or weakening writer ownership/durability. Verify end-to-end owner/restart/sequence parity and benchmark burst/sparse streams before daily-use readiness.

followUp.implemented: Provider-only pre-sequence coalescing with immediate leading chunks and safe failed-sink finalization.
followUp.remaining: Final evidence delivery/hosted gate; no additional persistence batching planned without a new measured problem.

remainingGate: Final source/target/media/workspace comparison, sealed authority selection, interruption recovery and rollback/retirement remain A2. G2 upstream regression enforcement remains a separate release gate.
